title: Castle of Secrets: The Great Hall
steps: Fireplace: use Taper on Fire → get Lit taper
Fireplace: use Poker on Ashes → get Brass gear, Charred note
Grandfather clock: use Brass gear on Clock face
Grandfather clock: Clock hands → solve "Clock hands" (answer: 7 15)
Grandfather clock: Pendulum → get Silver key
Dining table: use Silver key on Jewelry box → get Signet ring
Dining table: use Lit taper on Candelabra → solve "Candelabra" (answer: III I IV II)
Dining table: Folded letter → get Folded letter
Portrait: use Signet ring on Crest on the frame
Portrait: Inside the safe → get Iron key
Iron gate: use Iron key on Gate lock
